notes.title: Quality of life changes + bug fixes
notes.notes:
Lately we've had a few streamers play our game, big thanks to them!

Today we give you a quality of life fix along with some bug fixes as well:

Quality of life fix:

- Gave clearer instructions for the Jester's quest at the beginning of the game (because some were struggling with figuring it out)

Bug fixes:

- Fixed a bug where dialogue for accepting King's Fran's quest with a herb would appear after entering and leaving the King and Queen of Foreline's bedroom

- Fixed a bug where achievements with long names wouldn't display properly

notes.title: Bug fixes + translation update #2
notes.notes:
Well, as we said last update we weren't going to do any more small updates for a while until the next big update, but we found a game-breaking bug that caught our attention and we had to fix it post-haste. So here we are 💅

- Fixed a game breaking bug that made you get a game over despite a loss being scripted, making you unable to complete Courtesan Route

- Fixed a bug where going out of the Forelinian Jester's house in Passive would make you do the berry quest all over again

On the bright side, an update to the Russian Translation: This is fairly close to completion! Pernecious and Courtesan Route are already fully translated, while Normal/ill and the Merry Men routes are halfway finished! Won't be too long now!

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Unless there's another bug that gets reported to us, this will probably be the last bug fix update for a little while until the Russian translation is implemented.

Anyway, here's the bugs we fixed!

- Fixed a bug where reading a scroll about the "gods" of Nor in the library late in the game will take you back to an earlier part of the game (this is odd, we thought we fixed this a long time ago!)

- Fixed a bug where the wrong attack sound would play when killing Forelinian Peasant Joey

notes.title: Bug fixes + translation update
notes.notes:
[p]Added some bug fixes we didn't notice we forgot in yesterday's update until today!

- Fixed a bug where it was thought you found a scroll in the library when you actually hadn't

- Fixed a bug in Passive route where the door was unlocked to the Forelinian castle before completing the first few quests[/p][p][/p][p]In other news, the dubbed voice acted cutscenes for the big Russian translation update are about 80% complete! After the cutscenes are finished being dubbed the focus will be fully on translating the dialogue within the game itself![/p]

notes.title: Quality of life update
notes.notes:
A (rather small) but much needed quality of life update!

-Since it would make more logical sense in the game's context, and noting how Klames acts in the game (which is uncharacteristic of this title), we have since changed the 'sin' portion of Klames' title and given it to Phantom Scott instead. So now Klames is strictly the "goddess" of love instead of the "goddess" of love and sin, and Phantom Scott is the "god" of sin. This change makes more logical sense to Phantom Scott himself, as this title is more applicable towards Phantom Scott more than being applicable to Klames. We will apply this to the Steam Store page photos soon as well

- "Woohoo"-ing now also restores your MP instead of just your HP

- Applied a shortened dialogue option in ill route towards the route's end

notes.title: Bug fixes + Translation update
notes.notes:
Apparently in the Norian Summer update, we accidently replaced an event in the Forlinian library at the beginning of the game with another. We've fixed this issue!

As with the Russian translation, it's going slowly but smoothly! At least 25% of the game has been translated!

These achievements are integrated for both versions of the game (the version[/p][p]on Steam and its sister version Itch.io), so everyone can be able to experience them no[/p][p]matter what version they play![/p][p][/p][p]As for future updates, we plan on adding some new characters/quests as well as a Russian[/p][p]translation! notes.title: Norian Summer Mega Update!
notes.notes: [p][b][i]Do you know what a Norian summer is?[/i][/b][/p][p]A Norian summer is a culture festival where each kingdom enjoys about three months of peace from the beginning of May to the end of August. Each kingdom moves to another to live there for three months and learn about their cultures. For example, Foreline goes to Liylah, Shadvaille to Foreline, Incen to Icedrift, Icedrift to Incen, etc. The kingdoms you're able to go to changes in rotation every year, but it is the highlight for Norians who live in a kingdom![/p][p][/p][p]However, due to the war between Foreline, Icedrift, and Liylah 2 years ago, the Lylian king has forbidden people to go to Liylah during Norian summer. Due to this, the kingdoms haven't been able to have it ever since. Perhaps you can change that with the help of a peace treaty![/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Voice Acted Cutscenes![/b][/p][p]There have been 8 voice acted cutscenes that have been added throughout the game! These help expand the world around you and show that some things aren't as they seem... (And if you've seen these before while taking a different route, you can skip them by pressing the "Enter" key! However, some routes have an exclusive cutscene, so don't go breezing through!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Quests![/b][/p][p]New quests have been added! As well as more scenes have been added within the game to help flesh out prior scenes for their intended purpose![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Enhanced Mechanics![/b][/p][p]A quest indicator has been added! Now you can see who exactly needs help on the side![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Bug Fixes![/b][/p][p]A plethora of bug fixes has been added! Including but not limited to:[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock issue where you'd be unable to progress after giving Phantom Scott meat to help change the time of day in Normal/ill/Pernicious routes (how did we not find this earlier??)[/p][/*][*][p]Not really a bug but added in an optional hint on how to get the seaweed/key pieces in Liylah due to some complaining about the difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Maxwell would appear when he wasn't supposed to when equipping your sword in the Icedriftian castle during Normal/ill/Pernicious routes[/p][/*][*][p]And many more![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hast fortunate travels! We hope thou enjoy![/b][/p]

notes.title: Bug fixes + Route counter
notes.notes:
This round was interesting, we were made aware of a route counter that was actually hidden from us developers. Every time you complete a route in the same file you completed your previous routes and start a new one on, it adds a number to that save file starting with the second route you complete:

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/d007e83573ea2d5175fc04dda774cf9f/7d387a94b7cb76b7-10/s2048x3072/395f9f20af654bccf478359abf9714e8e16e1d99.pnj[/img]

This will be very useful for keeping track of how many routes you have completed/started when you're trying to 100% the game!

Anyway, the round of bug fixes for this update are as follows:

>Fixed a bug in Normal/ill/Pernicious routes where you could do the cockroach quest for Eustace the peasant multiple times (this one was strange, we thought we had fixed it prior)

>Fixed a tileset error in the Merry Men route

>Phantom Scott now has extra dialogue when killing NPCs in the Forelinian marketplace

notes.title: Softlock fix
notes.notes:
- Fixed a softlock in Normal/ill/Pernicious routes where Phantom Scott wouldn't let you go into the queen's castle after killing Krungest in his house

This was a strange one, as this never happened with any of our playtesters until someone reported it to us. We've done this route several times and yet this never occured, so this was new to all of us. Very glad it was brought to our attention. Thanks!

If you find a bug or an issue like this, please go into the discussions tab and report it to us there (please be descriptive)

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatability Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We're proud to say that Crimson Snow Deluxe is playable on Steam Deck!

[b]Please go to the "Community Controls" tab and click on the "Official Crimson Snow Deluxe
Controls" on your Steam Deck to allow for the correct controls to be activated on your copy of the
game

Some areas will be required to use your touchscreen. Such as some quests or interacting with the
“Map of Nor” item.[/b]

We've also added an easier way to access the game's instruction manual! You may find it under Crimson Snow Deluxe's Steam store page!

There was a small texture error in the Forelinian mess hall that was found, so we fixed that as well

If you find a bug like that within the game, please contact the developers on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2944090/discussions/]Crimson Snow Deluxe’s Steam Community Page[/url] if you downloaded it through Steam or comment on Crimson Snow Deluxe’s Itch.io page if you have downloaded it through there. Both pages will be updated accordingly if there is a bug found on either one that needs attention
